title: Search as you type
description:
Make a search box model that cancels old searches and only shows the newest results.

```
type "t"   -> search started
type "te"  -> previous search cancelled, new search started
type "tea" -> previous cancelled
results for "tea": tea, teapot (2 cancelled, 1 finished)
```
hints: Keep the current controller in a variable outside; `current?.abort()` before making a new one (lesson 8.03).
`e.name === "AbortError"` tells a cancelled search from a real failure.
requirements: `onInput(text)` waits 150 ms of quiet (debounce), then starts a search with a fresh `AbortController`.
Starting a search aborts the one before; aborted searches are counted, not shown as errors.
The fake search function takes `(text, signal)` and takes a random 50 to 300 ms.
stretch: Cache results by text and skip the search when a result is already there.
